title: KoszulOpenHomChainRepresentatives
statement: Let A be a commutative ring and f:Fin r to A a finite sequence. Use the extended tails and termwise tilde complexes of [def-sc-koszul-open-system], the module Hom complex [def-sc-module-total-hom-complex], and the specified stage diagram and object isomorphisms of [def-sc-koszul-cech-comparison-construction]. Let F be a termwise quasi-coherent sheaf complex on Spec A, with both sheaf and module derived categories [def-pc-derived-category]. For a chain map t:tilde I_e to F, define its module transpose through the ordinary affine tilde/sections adjunction. Define its stage class by the Hom cocycle of that transpose, the cycle-kernel isomorphism and homology projection, the inverse localization/homology isomorphism, and H^0(Q(koszulCechHomObjIso.inv)). There are equivalences a_e:Hom(Q(tilde I_e),Q(F)) to H^0(Q(D_e)) taking Q(t) to exactly this constructed class. Every derived arrow Q(tilde I_e) to Q(F) equals Q(t) for some sheaf chain map t. No restriction or comparison to sections on U is asserted.

source.place: Proposition 36.9.5, stage derived-Hom identification; Tags 06Z0 and 0A8H

proof.text: For L the extended Koszul module tail, each negative term is an exterior power of the free module on Fin r; Mathlib LinearAlgebra/ExteriorPower/Basis.lean, Module.Free.exteriorPower, supplies a free basis, hence categorical projectivity. The extension is strictly at most zero. Apply bounded-above projective K-projectivity to L.

Use exists_affineQCohDerivedEquivalence and its natural tilde comparison to transport derived Hom by full faithfulness. The termwise ordinary tilde/sections counit on F is invertible by hF. Naturality of the comparison and the ordinary complex adjunction prove normalization on Q.map of chain maps. The existing CochainComplex.IsKProjective.exists_Q_map_eq then supplies a module chain representative, whose ordinary adjoint is the required sheaf representative.

Construct an additive equivalence between degree-zero Hom cocycles and the kernel of the module Hom differential. Compose with the module short-complex homology projection. Its kernel is precisely coboundaries and it is surjective, so it induces an additive equivalence from CohomologyClass to module Hom homology. Mathlib CohomologyClass.equivOfIsKProjective, SmallShiftedHom.equiv, and ShiftedHom.homEquiv give derived Hom, with normalization verified at degree zero. Compose these equivalences with the inverse localization/homology factor iso and the inverse of koszulCechHomObjIso. The resulting equivalence sends Q.map t to exactly koszulOpenHomStageClass. Zero tails and zero rings are included.

lean.statement:
theorem koszulOpenHom_chain_representatives
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{v} (ModuleCat.{u} A)]
    (F : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (hF : ∀ n : ℤ, (F.X n).IsQuasicoherent) :
    let H := DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0
    let D := koszulCechHomDiagram A r f
      (((affineOpenSections A ⊤).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj F)
    ∃ a : ∀ e : ℕ, (koszulOpenObject A r f e ⟶ DerivedCategory.Q.obj F) ≃
        H.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (D.obj e)),
      (∀ (e : ℕ) (t : koszulOpenSheafComplex A r f e ⟶ F),
        a e (DerivedCategory.Q.map t) = koszulOpenHomStageClass A r f F e t) ∧
      ∀ (e : ℕ) (φ : koszulOpenObject A r f e ⟶ DerivedCategory.Q.obj F),
        ∃ t : koszulOpenSheafComplex A r f e ⟶ F, DerivedCategory.Q.map t = φ
